method: Deterministic original-reference light matte and upward texture transport; no generated flame asset or local model
rootProcessing: Flame-only crop ends above the source seal; no stretched root or upright ring is baked in. Neighbouring original wisps replace the long saturated centre, retaining continuous translucent volume rather than erasing a vertical stripe.
animation: 32 phases, two strictly upward moving source samples with complementary smooth fades, root pinned; no serpentine UV warp or central bright-core enhancement
compositing: Premultiplied translucent flame with gentle light lift (1.10 colour / 0.90 opacity); circle retains normal-equivalent premultiplied compositing
seal: Original ring, side curves and front motif retained; source upright-flame contamination inside the rear ring reduced. Warmer low-alpha glow and measured low/mid orange-gold fill cover the complete inner disk.
artAcceptance: Final normal-range motion and filled-centre native review completed; user acceptance pending
